task: ae.deps semver dependency resolver with backtracking, prerelease rules and lockfile
reasoning_summary: Designed layers first: Version/Constraint (npm-style ranges desugared to comparators), Registry port with memory/text adapters, a complete backtracking Resolver with forward checking and lock preference, and an atomic lockfile. Tests combine literal tables, a semver-spec ordering chain and a seeded brute-force oracle over every assignment; four mutations were each killed. First run failed on a reversed prerelease comparison and on treating an unknown package as fatal inside the search; both fixed.
